subject: search5599@proton.me (N=1 within-subject)
design: longitudinal within-subject, 5 axes × 17 levels × N=10 = 170 sessions over ~14d

hypothesis_set.H1_caffeine: engagement (beta/alpha) at +30/+60min > pre-09:00 baseline (paired t, alpha=0.0025 Bonferroni)

criteria.C3_threshold_rule: new_lz76_baseline_x1000 = round((mean - 2*SD) * 1000) over all 170 resting sessions
criteria.criteria_provenance: Pre-registered 2026-04-28, frozen by raw#12. Transition rule replaces operational placeholder human_baseline_lz76_x1000=850 in clm_eeg_p1_lz_pre_register.json with empirical mean-2SD once N>=170 reached; old 0.85 retracted per raw#82 protocol, NOT silently overwritten.

falsifiers.F1: fixed-pattern synthetic stream (16ch identical FNV seed) -> LZ76 within ±5% across all 170 sessions (no real signal variability) -> design FALSIFIED
falsifiers.F2: between-condition mean(LZ76) variance < within-condition SD (no axis effect detectable) -> hypotheses set H2/H3 FALSIFIED for this subject
falsifiers.F3: ledger row missing required field {session_id, timestamp, axis, level, lz76_x1000, gamma_theta_x1000, engagement_x1000, drowsy_x1000, board_health_pass, impedance_max_kohm} -> session NULLIFIED, gap logged
falsifiers.F4: session_id collision (sha256 of timestamp+axis+level) within ledger -> idempotency FALSIFIED, halt and audit raw#65
falsifiers.F5: post-hoc edit to criteria block (frozen_at older but file mtime newer) detected by chflags uchg unlock log -> raw#12 violation, full retraction triggered raw#82

honest_limits_raw91_c3.single_subject: results generalise to this subject only; no claim about other subjects, populations, or clinical groups
honest_limits_raw91_c3.carryover: caffeine half-life 5-6h; between-day washout protocol = no caffeine after 14:00 on session-days; not perfect
honest_limits_raw91_c3.adherence: depends on user willpower; missed sessions = ledger gaps, NO imputation, gaps reported as-is
honest_limits_raw91_c3.order_effects: circadian axis intrinsically ordered; caffeine/postmeal/postexercise/sleep rotated via daily plan; full counterbalancing impossible at N=1
honest_limits_raw91_c3.hardware_drift: per-session board_health_check + impedance Z logged; drift > 20% across 14d = sub-cohort split
